items.title: Pay translation invoice
items.quote: Kindly transfer the total within 21 days of the date of this invoice, quoting the invoice number.
items.computation: Invoice date = 21 November 2026 (Saturday). Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (invoice date) is not counted; the 21-day period starts 22 November 2026 and runs 21 days, ending 12 December 2026 (a Saturday, 3 weeks after 21 Nov). Since the last day of the period falls on a Saturday, § 193 BGB moves it to the next working day. 13 December 2026 is a Sunday, so the due date moves to Monday 14 December 2026. No relevant public holidays (NW, payer's own Land) fall in this window.
